findings.reason: as written the node either breaks a landed test and fails its own gate, or must keep a delegating shim under the old name, and neither is stated; the plan must either add `tests/test_a_resume_runs_under_its_dispatch_policy.py` to §8's write paths (to repoint its monkeypatch at `runs.recorded_dispatch_overrides`) or say the private name stays as a thin delegate to the new owner.
findings.text: §8's deliverable says `crew_run_commands.py` "drops its private `_recorded_dispatch_overrides` and calls the owner", but the landed §7 test `tests/test_a_resume_runs_under_its_dispatch_policy.py:186` does `real = crew_run_commands._recorded_dispatch_overrides` and `:192` does `monkeypatch.setattr(crew_run_commands, "_recorded_dispatch_overrides", spy)` (reproduced at base 47c10fa50: 1 passed), so dropping the name raises AttributeError on line 186 and reddens that test; §8's done-when at line 200 instead requires "the test files that import … `reckon/crew_run_commands.py` give the same pass and fail ids at head as at base", and §8's declared write paths (`reckon/crew/runs.py`, `reckon/crew_run_commands.py`, `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py`, `tests/test_a_run_s_overrides_have_one_reader.py`) do not include that §7 test file

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the owner is to be added in `reckon/crew/runs.py` beside `read_pointer` (`reckon/crew/runs.py:641`); the cited `_recorded_dispatch_overrides` (`reckon/crew_run_commands.py:21`), `_resolve_lane_config` (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:127`) and its hand read (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:132-133`) all resolve, as do the cited module paths.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §8's done-when is measurable (a grep that no module reads `dispatch_options` overrides but the owner, plus two tests) and it declares a negative control ("with `_resolve_lane_config`'s hand read restored, the second test's admission case fails").
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the negative control is logged under the run directory, a durable path, not a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `recorded_dispatch_overrides` and `tests/test_a_run_s_overrides_have_one_reader.py` are named by mechanism; no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag appears.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8's deliverable (drop `crew_run_commands`' private `_recorded_dispatch_overrides`) cannot produce §8's own done-when (the files importing `crew_run_commands.py` must give the same pass/fail ids at head as at base), because a landed §7 test dereferences and monkeypatches that exact attribute and §8's write paths exclude that test file.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8 carries one deliverable: one owner for a run's recorded overrides, with `crew_run_commands` and `queue_admission._resolve_lane_config` both calling it.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §8 introduces no new node relationship and rests only on §7, whose helper `_recorded_dispatch_overrides` exists at `reckon/crew_run_commands.py:21`; the plan's sole relationship meta is `plan-after: a-held-dispatch-waits-its-fair-turn`, unchanged by this unit.
